Description: Minor hand laceration while replacing gland packing on MTR-75 (Induction Motor) at Lephalale Boiler House; first aid treatment only.
Technician found without required face shield while servicing MTR-75 (Induction Motor) at Emalahleni Slurry Line during packing replacement.
RootCause: PPE station near work area was not restocked after previous shift's use.
CorrectiveAction: Work paused, correct PPE issued, task resumed.
PreventiveAction: Add PPE station stock check to shift handover checklist.

Description: CVA-30 (Control Valve Actuator) at Emalahleni Slurry Line failed to reach commanded position during control loop stroke test.
RootCause: Positioner calibration drifted outside tolerance; feedback linkage showed early wear.
CorrectiveAction: Recalibrated positioner zero/span, replaced feedback linkage bushing.
PreventiveAction: Add positioner calibration check to quarterly PM instead of annual only.

Description: CP-450 (Centrifugal Pump) at Rustenburg Concentrator tripped on high bearing temperature alarm during normal operation.
RootCause: Bearing frame under-greased at last PM interval; grease quantity did not match lubrication chart.
CorrectiveAction: Replaced bearing set, re-greased per chart, verified alignment within spec.
PreventiveAction: Audit PM checklist sign-off against lubrication chart values; retrain team on grease volumes.

Description: CP-450 (Centrifugal Pump) at Rustenburg Concentrator showing reduced discharge pressure versus commissioning baseline.
RootCause: Impeller-to-liner clearance exceeded adjustment range due to progressive wear.
CorrectiveAction: Replaced impeller and liner set; reset clearance to OEM spec.
PreventiveAction: Shorten clearance-check interval from monthly to bi-weekly on this duty point.
